bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags must be smaller than an 8.5 x 11 inch sheet of paper. Diaper bags and medical bags are allowed but may be screened. There's no free storage for bags, but Venue Vault smart lockers can be rented next to the Taproom bathrooms.
allowed: Clear bags smaller than 8.5 x 11 inches
bagPolicy.quote: Clear bags must be smaller than an 8.5” x 11” piece of paper.

parking.summary: Street parking nearby depends on availability. Downtown garages include Park 2 at 2651 First Avenue North, Park 3 next to City Hall at 210 North 27th Street, and the Empire Parking Garage on Montana Avenue next to The Northern Hotel.
parking.quote: Nearby street parking is contingent on availability.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Pub Station Taproom. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages are not allowed. There are two ATMs, one in the lobby and one outside next to the ticket window.
concessions.quote: Yes, we have two ATM’s. One is located in the lobby and the other is located outside next to the ticket window.

accessibility.summary: The venue is ADA compliant. To reserve an ADA seat, call 406-894-2020 during office hours or email cory@1111presents.com at least 48 hours before doors. Documented service animals are allowed.
accessibility.quote: Yes, we are compliant with all ADA regulations.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry. Once you leave, you can't come back in that night.
reEntry.quote: There is NO RE ENTRY once you are in the venue.

ticketPickup.summary: You can buy tickets online through Etix or in person at the Pub Station Taproom, 2502 First Avenue North, where box office sales carry an extra per-ticket fee. Age limits vary by show. Guests 21 and over get a wristband, and anyone under 21 or without valid ID gets an X on both hands.

gates.summary: The time on each event listing is when doors open, and the show usually starts about an hour later. Security may search guests before entry.
gates.quote: The times posted on each event indicate the time that doors open.
